schedule: cosine over 2940 completed optimizer updates; no warmup
objective: three-class cross entropy; no label smoothing or additional inverse-class weights
sampler: uniform class, then uniform available domain, then uniform known tyre/unresolved source clip group, then uniform image; replacement
augmentation: query atlas only; independent brightness/contrast/saturation factors uniform [0.9,1.1]; seed-addressed per occurrence; validity preserved
bank_policy: fixed 18 literal training-source patches; all deterministic prototype cases retained; no appearance exclusions or validation/test case selection
bank_risks: paint/marker lines, glare, blur, partial tyre coverage, identity shortcuts; logged grayscale/brightness/occlusion probes, no human groove labels
selection: maximum validation observed-ground-truth-class BA (low/high), then minimum three-class NLL, then earliest epoch; no test selection
test_role: 103 previously inspected historical test images; existing-cohort development only
diagnostic_scope: all selected/final endpoint images; no diagnostic-based checkpoint selection
